outcomeClusters.title: Basic Concepts & Definitions
outcomes: State the speed of light in vacuum.
State the difference between reflection, refraction, and absorption of light.
Define focal length, focal point, principal axis, and image.

outcomeClusters.title: Reflection & Plane Mirrors
outcomes: Describe the properties of images formed by plane mirrors, including their size, orientation, type, and location.
Create a simple ray diagram for an image formed by a plane mirror, showing the location of the object, the mirror, and the virtual image.
Use the law of reflection to determine the angles of incidence and reflection in a problem.

outcomeClusters.title: Spherical Mirrors (Concave & Convex)
outcomes: Identify the concave and convex mirror.
Create ray diagrams for concave and convex mirrors, including the location of the object, image, and focal point.
Describe the characteristics of images formed by concave and convex mirrors, including their size, orientation, type, and location.

outcomeClusters.title: Refraction & Index of Refraction
outcomes: Calculate the speed of light in any medium using the index of refraction ($n = \frac{c}{v}$).
Describe the cause of refraction as the change of speed of light in a material.
Use Snell's law to calculate the index of refraction of either material (solve for index of refraction only).

outcomeClusters.title: Diffraction & Dispersion
outcomes: Describe how different frequencies of light bend differently and use this to explain diffraction of light.

outcomeClusters.title: Total Internal Reflection
outcomes: Identify and calculate the critical angle.
Define total internal reflection and when it occurs.
